title: Upstream mediawiki/page/change 1.12.0 (fields read by WikiPulse)
description: Subset of the Wikimedia mediawiki/page/change 1.12.0 event that the ingest service reads from the mediawiki.page_change.v1 stream. The ingest service validates every event against the full vendored upstream schema; this document lists the fields WikiPulse depends on, so an upstream change to any of them is a breaking change for WikiPulse.
$comment: Source: https://schema.wikimedia.org/repositories/primary/jsonschema/mediawiki/page/change/1.12.0 (Wikimedia Event Platform). Fields not listed here are ignored and not stored.

$schema.description: Upstream schema URI, e.g. /mediawiki/page/change/1.12.0. Major/minor are used for drift detection.

id.description: Unique event ID; the deduplication key end to end.

dt.description: Time the event was produced upstream (processing-side).

domain.description: Wiki domain. The value 'canary' marks synthetic monitoring events, which are dropped.

dt.description: Time the change happened in MediaWiki. Used as event time.

wiki_id.description: Database name of the wiki, e.g. enwiki.

user_text.description: User name or temporary account name. Pseudonymised at ingest; never stored.
